newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Byron, Ill. nuke boosts power output.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Byron, Ill. nuke boosts power output.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 1,105 megawatt Byron nuclear power unit 1 was boosting electricity production Friday after an outage which began Wednesday, a company spokesman said.
The unit was producing at 43 percent of capacity and increasing power as of Friday morning, and was expected to reach full power output early next week, spokesman Gary Wald said Friday.
The Byron, Ill. unit was accidentally tripped off line Sept 11 during a routine surveillance test, Wald said.
Also at ComEd, Wald said the 1,040 megawatt Zion nuclear power unit 1 should go into startup mode this weekend with anticipations of reaching full load next week, Wald said.
The unit, located at Cordova, Ill., was shut down August 27 for a repair to a motor operating valve.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
